title: On the Income tax depriciation screen the assement year shown should not have co
description: On the Income tax depriciation screen the assement year shown should not have co
originating_prompt:
On the Income tax depriciation screen the assement year shown should not have commas 2026 year should not be shown as 2,026
[follow-up] In the IT depreciation screen in the voew mode The assement year should not have a comma , ( 000 seperator ) it should be just numbers like 2026
result_summary:
I dug further into why the comma is still showing, and found the real (and final) answer.

**What's already fixed:** `target_columns.assessment_year.type` = `"string"`, and `source_sql`'s final SELECT casts it to `CAST(af.assessment_year AS TEXT)`. Both changes are still in place in `Metadata_Model/general_process_models/model_fam_gen_dep_it_asset_ledger.json`.

**Why the comma persists anyway:** the results grid (the same grid used in the designer's Live Preview, the workbench Run tab, and the deployed app) decides whether a column is "numeric" purely by sampling its displayed values — if every value in a column is a string of only digits (e.g. `"2026"`), it treats the column as numeric and formats it with `toLocaleString()`, adding the comma. It never looks at the model's declared column type or the SQL's cast. So no combination of `target_columns.type` or SQL casting in this object's JSON can stop it — `"2026"` will always look "numeric" to that check, cast or not.

This detection logic lives in the platform's own grid-rendering code, not in any file this project owns, so it's outside what I can change from the project side. I've left the two already-applied fixes in place (they're correct and harmless), but I can't make the on-screen comma disappear purely through the G-process model.

If you'd like, I can flag this as a platform enhancement request (a per-column "don't format as number" option in the General Process grid) rather than continue attempting project-level workarounds — let me know if you want me to do that or try something else.
